eula.activation.description: Harmonculus uses Moonbase to activate and manage licences. You can activate a licence online through your Ruminant Audio Works account or use the offline activation process. The free Moonbase trial lasts 14 days. MIDI playback and original-sample preview require a valid licence or an active trial.

product.buy.description: Early Access costs £24 as a one-off purchase through Moonbase. The standard price after Early Access will be £49.
product.buy.platforms: One Harmonculus licence covers macOS, Windows, Linux and supported standalone Akai MPCs.
product.buy.title: Buy
product.control.description: Shape how the sound responds with filter key tracking, velocity, polyphonic glide and unison. With MPE, pressure moves the level and slide moves the filter. Turn up Vintage for the slow pitch wander of tape.
product.control.image: Control tab showing voice controls, modulation matrix, arpeggiator, envelopes, ladder filter and FET compressor.
product.control.title: Play the partials
product.download.description: Download Harmonculus 0.3.0 and try it free for 14 days.
product.download.linuxInstall: On Linux, extract the archive and run bash install.sh from the extracted folder as the user who runs your DAW.
product.download.title: Download
product.effects.description: Reorder stereo chorus, tempo-synced delay and convolution reverb. Filter the echo into a narrow dub repeat, or give the reverb some predelay to keep the attack up front.
product.effects.image: Effects tab with Chorus, Delay and Reverb active on Damped Attack Bloom.
product.effects.title: Give it a space
product.hero.caption: Crossing Harmonic Bands · 45 partials
product.hero.description: Start with a preset, or drop in a sample and turn it into an instrument. Mould the harmonics with your mouse in 3D, like sonic putty.
product.hero.image: Harmonculus shows colourful partial envelopes in a 3D graph and a linked 2D editor.
product.meta.description: Additive synthesis with 365 instrument presets and a dedicated library of 365 presets for drums and percussion. Mould your own samples in 3D.
product.meta.image: Harmonculus spectral editor showing the Crossing Harmonic Bands preset
product.meta.social: Explore 365 instrument presets and 365 presets for drums and percussion, or turn a sample into an instrument. For macOS, Windows and Linux.
product.meta.title: Harmonculus | Additive Resynthesis Plugin for Desktop
product.name: Harmonculus
product.nav.label: Main menu
product.release.formats: Harmonculus is available as VST3 and VST2 for macOS, Windows and Linux, AAX for macOS and Windows, and Audio Unit (AU) for macOS.
product.release.title: Early Access
product.sample.description: Import a recording and Harmonculus analyses it into partials. Draw the level of each partial over time, then loop the motion or lock it to the tempo of your session. Turn a drum hit into a sequence or stretch a chord into a drone.
product.sample.title: Make an instrument from a sample.
product.taype.preview.alt: Explore TayPE. The reel-to-reel tape transport above the multitrack mixer.
product.vault.browser.caption: Click the preset name in Harmonculus to browse by bank or category and filter by rating.
product.vault.browser.image: The preset browser open to the Analogue Dreams bank, with Driven Double Saw Bass selected and preset ratings visible.
product.vault.browser.large: View the preset browser full size
product.vault.demos: All eight demos below use instrument presets, with no additional instruments or processing.
product.vault.intro: Explore 365 instrument presets, voiced and refined with care. The sounds take inspiration from Boards of Canada, Air and other artists we love.
product.vault.percussion: A dedicated drums and percussion library adds another 365 presets, from acoustic hits and analogue drum-machine sounds to log drums, reverse cymbals and cinematic taiko.
product.vault.title: From the vault
